bio: A warm and welcoming setting, where hospitality stands out for its authenticity and attention to detail. The kitchen, under the direction of chef Matthias Kirchler, presents creative, refined dishes designed for those who love to experiment and be surprised. The gastronomic offering has been recently refreshed and now unfolds in two distinct journeys: “Alpes 1988” and “Alpes – Locanda” for culinary experiences that narrate the territory with contemporary flair....
